title: More reliable swipe starts
summary: Horizontal navigation now starts reliably from more of each page and tolerates natural diagonal thumb movement without interfering with clearly vertical scrolling.
changes: Horizontal page swipes can now begin from normal empty space inside status rows, workflow strips, date controls and Chat list containers instead of those whole regions being treated as blocked.
Actual buttons, links, inputs, text areas and other interactive controls remain protected from accidental navigation.
The direction lock now tolerates the small diagonal wobble that commonly happens at the beginning of a thumb swipe while clearly vertical movement continues to scroll normally.
The viewport-pinned page track, roster logic, Supabase data, authentication, staffing rules and clinical workflows are unchanged.
